commands.name: search-observations
commands.summary: Search wildlife observations by text, taxon, place, user, quality grade and date range, with sorting and pagination

commands.name: get-observation
commands.summary: Get full details of one observation by its numeric id: taxon, photos, location, identifications and observer

commands.name: list-species-counts
commands.summary: Count observed species (leaf taxa) matching observation filters, e.g. the most-observed species in a place

commands.name: list-top-observers
commands.summary: List the users with the most observations that match the given filters (taxon, place, project)

commands.name: search-taxa
commands.summary: Search taxa (species, genera, families and so on) by scientific or common name, optionally filtered by rank

commands.name: get-taxon
commands.summary: Get details of a taxon by numeric id: name, rank, ancestry, common name, conservation status and Wikipedia summary

commands.name: search-places
commands.summary: Find places (countries, states, parks and so on) by name to get the place_id that the observation filters use

commands.name: search-projects
commands.summary: Search iNaturalist projects (bioblitzes, collections, umbrella projects) by name

commands.name: get-user
commands.summary: Get a user's public profile (login, name, observation and species counts) by login or numeric id

commands.name: list-identifications
commands.summary: List identifications (species IDs that users added to observations), filterable by taxon, identifier and whether they are current
